strings.p4x.0x41d1f: The land of Scandor has a long and rich history. For centuries its peoples have lived side by side, sometimes in peace, sometimes in strife.
strings.p4x.0x41d8c: Scandor is the birthplace of many different races. Deep beneath their wish for peace and stability lay a small shard of malice.
strings.p4x.0x41e03: That stability was shattered by the coming of Nikademus. He is evil incarnate, created by wicked wizards whom the gods had banished to the Plane of Darkness. Made for revenge, Nikademus sent demons and devils into Scandor and laid waste to all he could.
strings.p4x.0x41ef8: Nikademus began by sending a fairly small force of Black Knights to the island of Gelnor, and ruled it by terror. But the attempt collapsed when a handful of adventurers defeated the Black Knights, and he suffered a heavy blow.
strings.p4x.0x41fc7: For a time Nikademus laid a terrible curse on the small island of Ferronrah. The curse was sealed in an evil crystal orb, guarded by nine beasts. But once again a handful of heroes slew the beasts Nikademus had loosed, the evil orb was destroyed, and Ferronrah was saved.
strings.p4x.0x420c2: Twice defeated, Nikademus gathered the evil beasts, devils, demons and scum that remained and forged them into a mighty army. He invaded Scandor, and a wave of destruction swept over the whole land. All the great warriors of Scandor rose up and faced Nikademus.
strings.p4x.0x421b3: Nikademus gave the title of Black Lord to a mighty warrior who joined him, hoping to conquer Scandor and fulfil his great ambitions, and let him rule Scandor. But the Black Lord grew more and more unhappy with that role. In the end Nikademus was defeated, and the power of good covered Scandor.
strings.p4x.0x422b6: With the help of Lord Wood and his adviser, the sage Filmon, the great warriors were able to strike Nikademus down. From that time on there was peace in Scandor.
strings.p4x.0x42357: Today Scandor is divided among several governments. The strongest of them rules the lands around Pendragon. Its ruler is Lord Geoffrey, son of Lord Wood. He has gone to investigate strange events in the western islands.

strings.o16.876: Written on the wall in dye:$"I am Filmon the sage. I know you have come here seeking Lord Geoffrey."
strings.o16.988: "Before I tell you everything, you must go to the Pookny Islands and find Zeus Juice. You will need it for your quest."
strings.o16.1113: "Let me give you some advice to help your quest. Lord Geoffrey went to the Pookny Islands, came back and wrote this poem:"
strings.o16.1222: "On this island there were two creatures, creatures of most peculiar shape.
strings.o16.1289: "One has seven heads, two hands and six feet, and nests in a golden dish. One has but one head, yet five hands and as many as nine feet, and spins silver thread."
strings.o16.1412: "Do not forget to come back here with the Zeus Juice."
strings.o16.1500: The dye on the wall has faded.$A man stands in a dyed alcove in the wall.$"I am Filmon," says the man.
strings.o16.1603: "It seems you could not solve the riddle of the two creatures. I will repeat the poem once more."
strings.o16.1687: "You must go back to the Pookny Islands and get the Zeus Juice. It is absolutely necessary."
strings.o16.1772: "Well done bringing back the Zeus Juice. You understand how precious it is. Do not use it until it is absolutely necessary."
strings.o16.1883: "I will tell you what I told Lord Geoffrey. There are two ways to get onto Skull Island past the barrier.
strings.o16.1985: "One way is to use Zeus Juice. With it you can cast the Super Transport spell and cross to Skull City.
strings.o16.2104: "The other way is better, since it costs none of your precious Zeus Juice. First you must go to level 7 of the Netherworld.
strings.o16.2239: "From there you can cross the river Styx to level 8 of the Netherworld. To cross the river you need Charon's Raft and Charon's Staff.
strings.o16.2366: "When you reach level 8 of the Netherworld, look for Nikademus's old laboratory.
strings.o16.2428: "Nikademus must have built the energy barrier in that laboratory. The barrier protects Nikademus's son Arathamus until he is strong enough to rule Scandor.
strings.o16.2580: "Lord Geoffrey believed that Arathamus would raise an army of hundreds of thousands of creatures, most of them from the Netherworld.
strings.o16.2691: "Arathamus is now planning his campaign inside the energy barrier with hundreds of generals. They will soon be ready, and that dreadful army will invade Scandor.
strings.o16.2840: "Before entering the barrier, Lord Geoffrey was desperately trying to collect Zeus Juice. The person he spoke with was his friend Lord Charles, in the House of Death.
strings.o16.2964: "I cannot tell you how to reach level 7 of the Netherworld, nor how to obtain Charon's Raft or Charon's Staff.
strings.o16.3078: "I believe you will need at least two Zeus Juices to defeat Arathamus and his generals.
strings.o16.3161: "When you reach the Skull Fortress, remember: first rescue Lord Geoffrey, then call out Arathamus."
